title: Concept: MLflow tracking UI is reachable without authentication
description: The tracking server is the experiment record: parameters, metrics, tags, source paths and artefact URIs. It frequently stores database connection strings in tags and model files in artefacts, so a public UI is a public model registry.
applicability: Responses from an MLflow tracking server on a reachable host.
risk: The caller enumerates experiments and downloads model artefacts, which are executable payloads in a deployment pipeline.
